note: Stanbic Bank Uganda's personal and private banking tariff guide (effective 27 March 2026): its credit card costs UGX 150,000 a year and charges 3% a month on the balance used; the excise duty the guide adds on bank charges states no rate and isn't written, nor is the UGX 22,600 issue fee. The table's text runs out of order, so its rows were matched by eye.
